title: Gemini 4 Argon Sets SoTA Record on WANDR Benchmark

tickers.name: Alphabet Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
Perplexity has integrated a new frontier AI from Google into its fast search and Computer agent modes for all users. The Gemini 4 Argon model is also accessible to Pro and Max subscribers and recently established a new State-of-the-Art (SoTA) record on the Wide-And-Deep-Research (WANDR) benchmark.

The WANDR benchmark measures a model's ability to conduct extensive research across diverse information sources. Perplexity CEO Arav Srinivas announced the integration on social media, which Google CEO Sundar Pichai later highlighted in a retweet.
